user.title: Luceco Floodlight
user.description: Enter the floodlight's IP address. Give it a fixed address, for example with a DHCP reservation, so it does not change.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Luceco Floodlight
reconfigure.description: Enter the floodlight's new IP address.

error.cannot_connect: Could not talk to the floodlight. Check the IP address and that the device is not locked. The Home Assistant log has details.
error.unsupported: The device answered but does not look like a Luceco smart floodlight.

abort.wrong_device: That address belongs to a different device.
